name: AIO-16A 16-port analog I/O card (ADAM, ADAM-M)
notes: 16 analog 4-wire intercom ports per card, up to 17 per ADAM. Hot-swap, detects the back card, drop-in replacement for the AIO-16. Ports 1-16 on each frame are fixed by slot. Back card (ordered separately): 50-pin SCSI (to XCP-40-DB9, XCP-40-RJ12, XCP-24, XCP-24-USOC, XCP-955), 50-pin MDR (separate data driver per keypanel; to XCP-32-DB9, XCP-16-DB9-T, XCP-48-RJ45) or RJ-45 (ADAM-M only). Each 50-pin connector carries 8 ports.

name: AIO-16 16-port analog I/O card (legacy)
notes: Earlier 16-port AIO card (9000-7726-001 with LED front). Same back cards as the AIO-16A. Ports 1-16 on each frame are fixed by slot. Back card (ordered separately): 50-pin SCSI (to XCP-40-DB9, XCP-40-RJ12, XCP-24, XCP-24-USOC, XCP-955), 50-pin MDR (separate data driver per keypanel; to XCP-32-DB9, XCP-16-DB9-T, XCP-48-RJ45) or RJ-45 (ADAM-M only). Each 50-pin connector carries 8 ports.

name: MADI-16 Plus MADI interface card, 16-64 ports
notes: AES10 MADI card, 16 to 64 ports at 44.1/48 kHz, coax or fibre back card. In an ADAM-M it goes in slot 8. Check: back card connectors.

name: OMI OMNEO matrix interface card, 16-64 ports
notes: OMNEO (Dante / AES67) IP audio card for ADAM and ADAM-M, 16 to 64 ports. Back card: 2 RJ45 plus 1 LC SFP. 14.9 W front and back.

name: RVON-16 16-port VoIP card (ADAM)
notes: RTS Voice Over Network card: 16 VoIP ports to RVON keypanels and RVON-I/O. Check: back card connectors (one RJ45 shown).

name: MCII-e master controller card (ADAM, ADAM-M)
source: RTS MCII-e user manual and ADAM-M installation manual (manualslib)
notes: Ethernet master controller. Fit two (main and backup) with matching DIP switches. Back card J1 Ethernet to AZedit, J2 to J12 on the XCP-ADAM-MC breakout panel (RS-232, trunking and peripheral RS-485, GPI). Check: J2 connector type.

name: TBX Tribus bus expander card
notes: Triple-bus expander linking up to 4 ADAM frames over dual fibre ring or mesh. In an ADAM-M the TBX cards go in slots 4-6 (then only one MADI card fits). Check: fibre connector type.

name: Cronus AIO 8-port analog I/O card
notes: 8 analog 4-wire intercom ports. RJ-12 back card (8 jacks) or MDR back card (one 50-pin MDR, to XCP-48-RJ45, XCP-32-DB9, XCP-48-Telco).

name: RVON-C 8-port VoIP card (Cronus)
notes: RTS Voice Over Network card for Cronus: 8 VoIP ports. Check: back card connectors (one RJ45 shown).

name: XCP-40-DB9 breakout panel, 40 x DB9 from 5 x SCSI 50-pin
source: RTS AIO-16 user manual and matrix brochure
notes: Breaks the matrix back card multipins out to one DB9 per intercom port (keypanel or 4-wire). For AIO SCSI back cards. Check: rack height and which face the connectors are on (all shown on the rear).

name: XCP-40-RJ12 breakout panel, 40 x RJ12 from 5 x SCSI 50-pin
source: RTS AIO-16 user manual and matrix brochure
notes: Breaks the matrix back card multipins out to one RJ12 per intercom port (keypanel or 4-wire). For AIO SCSI back cards (also written XCP-40-RJ11). Check: rack height and which face the connectors are on (all shown on the rear).

name: XCP-32-DB9 breakout panel, 32 x DB9 from 4 x MDR 50-pin
source: RTS AIO-16 user manual and matrix brochure
notes: Breaks the matrix back card multipins out to one DB9 per intercom port (keypanel or 4-wire). For AIO and Cronus MDR back cards; also works with AIO-8. Check: rack height and which face the connectors are on (all shown on the rear).

name: XCP-16-DB9-T breakout panel, 16 x DB9 from 2 x MDR 50-pin
source: RTS AIO-16 user manual and matrix brochure
notes: Breaks the matrix back card multipins out to one DB9 per intercom port (keypanel or 4-wire). For MDR back cards, with audio isolation transformers. Check: rack height and which face the connectors are on (all shown on the rear).

name: XCP-48-RJ45 breakout panel, 48 x RJ45 from 6 x MDR 50-pin
source: RTS AIO-16 user manual and matrix brochure
notes: Breaks the matrix back card multipins out to one RJ45 per intercom port (keypanel or 4-wire). For AIO and Cronus MDR back cards (MDR back card required). Check: rack height and which face the connectors are on (all shown on the rear).

name: XCP-ADAM-MC master controller breakout panel
source: RTS MC-ADAM and ADAM-M installation manuals
notes: Breaks the MCII-e controller back card out to the AZedit PC (RS-232), trunk master (RS-485), PAP/UIO-256/GPIO-16 peripherals and GPI. The brochure lists 10 DB9 and 1 DB25. Check: rack height and the use of J4-J10.

name: KP-3016 16-key keypanel, 1RU
notes: Entry-level 1RU keypanel, 16 lever keys with full-colour HD displays, 98 mm deep (110 mm with keys), 1.5 kg. OMNEO (IP) and 4-wire analog matrix connection. External 100-240 V supply, 11 W. User-replaceable headset XLR, 4 or 5-pin (KP-3016-A4F = 4-pin). Takes EKP-3016 expansion. Check: rear connector counts.

name: KP-3016A 16-key keypanel, 1RU (analog only)
notes: Entry-level 1RU keypanel, 16 lever keys with full-colour HD displays, 98 mm deep (110 mm with keys), 1.5 kg. Analog 4-wire matrix connection only. External 100-240 V supply, 8 W. User-replaceable headset XLR, 4 or 5-pin (KP-3016-A4F = 4-pin). Takes EKP-3016 expansion. Check: rear connector counts.

name: EKP-3016 16-key expansion panel, 1RU
notes: 1RU expansion panel, 16 lever keys with HD colour displays, for the KP-3016 / KP-3016A. -PB versions have pushbuttons. Check: link and power connectors.

name: EKP-4016 16-key expansion panel, 1RU
notes: 1RU expansion panel, 16 lever keys with HD colour displays, for the KP-4016 / KP-5032 (up to 7 / 6 per panel). -PB versions have pushbuttons. Check: link and power connectors.

name: PAP-5032 16-position IFB router panel, 2RU
notes: 2RU program assign panel: routes program sources to 16 IFB destinations, KP-5032 style keys and displays. Check: rear connectors.

name: RP-1000 32-key colour keypanel, 2RU
notes: 2RU, 32 keys with colour TFT displays, 83 mm deep, 2.9 kg. Rear connector kit: 6 aux, 3 relays, 4 opto inputs, 2 OC outputs. Optional OKI card (2 RJ45 + LC SFP, OMNEO) or RVON-2. RP-1932 is its 2RU colour expansion panel. Check: matrix and power connectors.

name: RP-1932 colour expansion panel for RP-1000, 2RU
notes: 2RU colour expansion panel for the RP-1000, 2.9 kg. Check: link connector and key count.

name: KP 12 CLD 12-key colour keypanel, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 12 keys with colour displays, 109 mm deep, 1.7 kg. Rear connector kit (KP 12 CLD RC): 3 aux, 3 relays, 4 opto inputs, 2 OC outputs. Optional OKI (OMNEO) or RVON-2 card. Check: matrix and power connectors.

name: KP-12 12-key keypanel, 1RU (legacy)
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU, 12 lever keys with displays, 140 mm deep, 2.3 kg (KP-12LK lever keys, KP-12PB pushbuttons). Option modules: KPM-CK (mic in/out, line in, headset, speaker) and KPM-I/O (4 opto, 2 OC, 2 relays). EKP-20 adds 20 keys. Check: rear connectors.

name: EKP-20 20-key expansion panel, 1RU (legacy)
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU, 20 keys with displays (EKP-20LK lever, EKP-20PB pushbutton), 181 mm deep, 2.1 kg. Check: link connector.

name: MKP-12 12-key value keypanel, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU value-series keypanel, 12 keys, 203 mm deep, 2.3 kg. Check: rear connectors.

name: PAM-16 16-key program audio monitor, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU program audio monitor panel with 16 monitor keys, 2 kg. PAM-32 is the 2RU version. Check: rear connectors.

name: LCP-12 level control panel, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU level control panel: 12 level controls for matrix crosspoints or ports, set in AZedit. Check: data and power connectors.

name: LCP-20 level control panel, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU level control panel: 20 level controls for matrix crosspoints or ports, set in AZedit. Check: data and power connectors.

name: LCP-32/16 level control panel, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU level control panel: 16 level controls, 44 mm deep for matrix crosspoints or ports, set in AZedit. Check: data and power connectors.

name: LCP-102 analog trim panel, 2RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 2RU, 16 channels each with a name display, output level knob and second level knob, address key, 181 mm deep, 3.8 kg. Connects to the matrix peripheral port (Zeus III, XCP-ADAM-MC). Check: rear connectors.

name: RVON-I/O 8-port VoIP interface, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 203 mm deep, 1.7 kg, 90-240 V AC. Carries 8 analog intercom ports (audio and keypanel data) over IP to an RVON-16 / RVON-C card or another RVON-I/O.

name: GPIO-16 general purpose I/O frame, 16 in / 16 relays
notes: 1RU, 16 opto-isolated inputs and 16 relay outputs, 178 mm deep, 2.5 kg. Front input status LEDs. Connects to the matrix peripheral bus (XCP-ADAM-MC J3, ODIN, Zeus). Check: GPIO connector types.

name: UIO-256 universal I/O frame, 16 GPI in / 16 out
notes: GPI interface: 16 inputs (remote keys for ports, party lines or outputs) and 16 outputs for lights, transmitters and paging. Legacy, replaced by the GPIO-16. Check: rack height and connectors.

name: IFB-828 IFB interface, 8 outputs, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 178 mm deep, 4 kg. Feeds up to 8 IFB beltpacks (4030 / IFB-325) with program and interrupt; 8 front level controls. Check: rear connectors.

name: 4010 central IFB electronics, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 381 mm deep, 4.9 kg. Central IFB electronics for the 4001 (4-channel) and 4003 (12-channel) control stations. Check: channel count and connectors.

name: TM-10K trunk master, 2RU
notes: 2RU, 305 mm deep, 12 kg. Links up to 256 matrix systems and 10,000+ users; dual PSUs, dual network interfaces, optional redundant trunk master. Check: trunk port count and connectors.

name: ICP-2000 trunk interface, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU companion to the TM-10K / TM-2000 trunk master. Check: function and connectors.

name: SWP-2000 trunk switch panel, 1RU
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: 1RU, 146 mm deep. Companion to the TM-10K trunk master (switches to the redundant trunk master). Check: function and connectors.

name: TIF-4000 12-line telephone interface, 4RU
notes: 4RU, 330 mm deep, 12.9 kg. Up to 12 analog telephone lines into the matrix (hybrids with auto-answer). Check: connector types.

name: SIP-ISDN telephone interface, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 216 mm deep, 1.4 kg. One ISDN S0 (2 lines) plus LAN for SIP calls into the matrix. Check: matrix connectors.

name: SAP-1626 source assignment panel, 2RU
notes: 2RU, 249 mm deep, 4.5 kg. Assigns 12 intercom and 3 program channels to 26 user stations; two 50-pin I/O connectors. Check: connector type.

name: RM-325 two-channel binaural user station, 1RU
notes: 1RU, 203 mm deep, 1.2 kg. Two-channel binaural TW user station. Check: rear connectors and rack width.

name: BOP-220 breakout panel, 20 XLR
source: RTS CAD drawing (DWF front view) and RTS matrix brochure
notes: Breakout panel with 20 XLRs (J101-J120, two rows of 10) and two multipin connectors, from the RTS drawing. Check: rack height, function and connector genders.
